text:
Type: storage bench with large drawer
Use: seating plus storage for toys or shoes; children's room, playroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: smooth white painted board, cut-out handles
Colors: white, dark handle recesses
Shape: low boxy bench with a flat slightly overhanging top, one deep full-width drawer, two cut-out finger pulls along the top edge, plinth base, compact and solid
Feel: clean, tidy, calm, practical
Goes with: white walls, light wood, colorful textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms or minimalist entryways

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
